name: patient_age_value_recorded_now_in_days
meaning: Numeric value indicating the patient's current age in days.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's age in days is unknown or not recorded.
when_value: Set to the patient's current age in days.

name: gestational_age_value_recorded_now_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value representing the patient's current gestational age in weeks.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current gestational age in weeks is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's current gestational age in weeks if known and recorded.

name: patient_gestational_age_value_recorded_now_in_weeks
meaning: Numeric value of the patient's gestational age in weeks, recorded at the current time.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's gestational age in weeks is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined at the current time.
when_value: Set to the numeric value of the patient's gestational age in weeks as recorded now.

name: parents_refuse_to_cooperate
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient's parents refuse to cooperate.
when_true: Set to true if the patient's parents refuse to cooperate.
when_false: Set to false if the patient's parents do not refuse to cooperate.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient's parents refuse to cooperate.

name: patient_has_finding_of_sepsis_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has sepsis.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has sepsis.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have sepsis.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has sepsis.

name: patient_has_finding_of_co_morbid_conditions_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has other comorbid conditions.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has other comorbid conditions.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have other comorbid conditions.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has other comorbid conditions.
